marathon.name: Atilla
marathon.bio: You better hold on tight! My name is Atilla and I've got legs and energy for days. I'm an active and driven guy who is looking for adventurous humans to share my life with. marathon.name: Naan

marathon.name: Wrigley
marathon.bio: Hey there!! I'm Wrigley! I'm a sweet girl looking for my forever home. Unfortunately this isn't the first time I have been in this situation, but I am hoping it is the last. I was lucky enough to find my way to the shelter the first time, but when I leave here it will be for the last time because you and me will be the forever kind of stuff. Less

I'm a smart girl (too smart for my own good sometimes) and I don't give my heart away easily but once you have it, it will be yours forever. I'd love for you to talk to staff about my past life and what I'm looking for in my future and maybe, if things go right, the things we need are one and the same.

She’s looking for a family who will give her the love and guidance she needs while also making sure she gets plenty of opportunities to learn, play, and explore. Bringing home Rory means signing up for puppy kisses, puppy antics, training, and all those little moments that make raising a dog so rewarding. clark.name: Luke
clark.bio: Luke may be the lone boy name surrounded by a litter of Gilmore Girls, but this Rat Terrier/Border Collie mix is every bit as ready for his starring role! Luke is a sweet and smart puppy who is looking for a family ready to make him part of their everyday lives. He’s got plenty of growing, learning, playing, and exploring ahead of him, and his future family will get to be there for all of it. He’ll need patience and guidance as he learns how to navigate the world, but that’s part of the fun of bringing home a puppy. Luke is ready for his forever family—and hopefully a lifetime of happy endings. Less

clark.name: Logan
clark.bio: Logan is one of the boys of our Gilmore Girl litter, and this Rat Terrier/Border Collie mix is ready to meet his future family! Logan is a sweet, smart puppy with a whole lifetime ahead of him. His new family will get to experience all the fun that comes with watching a puppy grow—from those goofy puppy moments to the satisfaction of seeing him learn something new. He’ll need a family who is ready to put in the time and patience that raising a puppy requires, but Logan will have so much potential to become an incredible lifelong companion. His forever story is just getting started. Could you be part of it?

clark.name: Tiny
clark.bio: Meet Tiny! Tiny came to CCHS as an owner surrender, previously set to be a barn cat however a little bit of wobble in her step had the owner bringing her over to us. This itty-bitty bashful gal is about 11 months old and weighs roughly 4.4lbs currently. Tiny is a sweet gal who is just a little unsure of things! She wasn't given a lot of socialization so she is the teeniest timid, but one thing for certain is that she looooves affection! She does not always know how to ask for it, but with a gentle touch and a little patience, she's very easy to win over. Tiny currently resides in our Kitty City with a number of other feline friends. Less

clark.name: Uecker

He may not have a career calling baseball games, but he's ready to become the MVP of someone's household! Uecker has his eyes on the biggest prize of all: a warm home, a loving family, and a lifetime contract filled with treats, toys, and plenty of attention. Will you be the one to bring this little all-star home? Because every all-star deserves a home team!

clark.name: Bowie
clark.bio: Bowie is one seriously entertaining puppy! This adorable terrier mix is energetic, playful, curious, and just a little bit crazy—in the absolute best puppy way. Bowie loves being part of the action and has never met a game he didn’t want to join. He’s got plenty of puppy zoomies, plenty of goofy antics, and plenty of opinions to share. His terrier personality shines through in his confidence, enthusiasm, and determination to investigate everything around him. Bowie is looking for a family ready to embrace puppyhood in all its chaotic glory and help him grow into the wonderful dog he’s meant to be. With training, exercise, and lots of love, this goofy guy is going to make someone a fantastic companion! Less

clark.name: Biggie
clark.bio: Biggie may have arrived as a stray, but hes quickly showing that underneath his unsure first impressions is a big-hearted dog just waiting for the right person to help him feel safe. At around 4 years old, Biggie is past the puppy chaos but still has plenty of life, love, and personality to share. He can be a little skittish when meeting new people or experiencing new environments, but give him a bit of time and patience and youll see the transformation-soft eyes, relaxed body language, and a whole lot of affection. Once Biggie trusts you, he leans in hard for love. He enjoys gentle attention, reassurance, and simply being near his person. Hes the kind of dog who bonds deeply and becomes incredibly loyal once he knows hes safe. Biggie will do best in a calm, patient home that understands he may need a little time to decompress and adjust. In return, he offers a big personality, a big heart, and a whole lot of love just waiting to come out. If youre looking for a diamond-in-the-ruff who just needs someone to believe in him, Biggie might be your guy. Less

clark.name: Rupert
clark.bio: Rupert has already had to overcome more than his fair share. He came to us as a stray with an injured leg, but thankfully he got the help he needed and is now ready to put that difficult chapter behind him. Rupert is a Pointer mix, but what really stands out about him isn’t his breed—it’s his incredibly sweet soul. This boy deserves the chance to experience the good side of life: a warm bed, a family who loves him, a safe place to call home, and people who will never let him wonder where his next meal or cuddle is coming from. Rupert has been given a second chance. Now he just needs someone willing to make that second chance permanent. Come meet this very special boy. clark.name: Cinnamon
clark.bio: A little spice with a whole lot of sweetness! Cinnamon is a 16-week-old Border Collie/Pug mix with a gorgeous tri-colored coat and a heart full of puppy love. This playful little baby loves having fun, spending time with people, and getting all the snuggles he can possibly squeeze in. Cinnamon is at that adorable age where the world is one big adventure, and he’s ready for a family to help him explore it! He’s looking for a home where he can grow, learn, play, and enjoy all the love a puppy deserves. If you’re looking for a sweet companion who can keep you smiling with his playful antics and melt your heart with her cuddles, Cinnamon might just be your perfect match!

clark.name: Slimer
clark.breed: German Shepherd Dog / Terrier (Unknown Type, Small)
clark.bio: Slimer, our adorable 12-week-old German Shepherd mix who's ready to haunt your home... with cuteness! This handsome little guy has a gorgeous tri-colored coat and a face that's almost impossible to say no to! Slimer is still just a baby, which means he's looking for a family ready to take on all the fun, training, patience, and adventures that come with raising a puppy! Unlike his ghostly namesake, this Slimer isn't looking to scare anyone away. He's just looking for a forever home to call his own!

clark.name: Lita
clark.bio: This beautiful 5-year-old tricolored Lab mix is ready to find her forever family. Lita weighs 83 pounds and is, admittedly, carrying a little extra love around with her! She would benefit from a family committed to helping her get back to a healthier weight through appropriate exercise, activity, and plenty of love. One thing Lita absolutely loves? Being outside! Whether she’s enjoying some fresh air, exploring the yard, or simply soaking up the sunshine, she’s happiest when she gets to spend time outdoors. If you’re looking for a sweet Lab mix who is ready to enjoy life by your side, come meet Lita! Less

clark.name: Rex
clark.bio: Your big handsome shepherd is here! Looking for a big guy to make an even bigger impression on your heart? Then come meet Rex! This handsome three-year-old German Shepherd sports the classic black and tan coat and weighs in at almost 90 pounds of pure shepherd goodness! Rex is a big guy looking for a home to call his own, German shepherds are known for their intelligence, loyalty and adventurous spirit and Rex is looking for someone ready to help him make the most out of his life outside of the shelter. At 90 ibs, Rex is definitely not small, and not a tiny lap dog... But who's to say he won't try? If you've got the room, in your home and heart, Rex is ready to move out of the shelter and into your life. Less

clark.name: Sylvester
clark.bio: Sylvester is a playful kitten with a curious mind and a fun-loving personality. He enjoys exploring new things, chasing toys, and showing off his kitten energy. Despite his adventurous side, he also enjoys quiet moments and affection from his favorite people. Sylvester is looking for a family that will cherish him through all stages of life.

clark.name: Janine
clark.breed: German Shepherd Dog / Terrier (Unknown Type, Small)
clark.bio: Janine, an adorable 12-week-old German Shepherd mix who's ready to answer the most important call of her life... the call to her forever home! Named after everyone's favorite Ghostbusters receptionist, this little lady is officially accepting applications for a permanent position as someone's best friend! Job requirements? Endless love, patience through puppyhood, plenty of training, and a cozy place to call home. Benefits? Puppy kisses, a loyal companion, and a lifetime of memories! Less

clark.name: Nutmeg
clark.bio: Sweet as her name, Nutmeg is a 16-week-old Border Collie/Pug mix with a beautiful brown coat and a whole lot of love to give! This little gal is the perfect combination of playful puppy energy and snuggly sweetness. She loves to play, explore, and soak up all the cuddles she can get. Nutmeg is still a baby, so she’s looking for a family ready to help her learn all about the world, teach her the ropes, and make plenty of memories along the way. Whether it’s playtime or curling up for some quality snuggle time, Nutmeg is ready to be your new best friend! Could this sweet little spice be the missing ingredient in your family? Less

clark.name: Darla
clark.bio: If you're looking for a dog with brains, loyalty, and a heart that's worth earning, meet Darla! Like many Heelers, Darla is incredibly intelligent and loves having a job to do. She's observant, eager to learn, and forms deep bonds with the people she trusts. Once you're part of her circle, you'll discover what a sweet, devoted companion she truly is. Darla can be a little shy when meeting new people and may take some time to warm up—especially around some men—but patience and kindness go a long way. She'll do best with someone who understands that trust isn't rushed, and that watching a timid dog blossom is one of life's greatest rewards. Darla is looking for an adult-only home, as she's not comfortable living with children. In the right environment, with people who respect her boundaries and appreciate her brilliant mind, she's sure to become an incredibly loyal best friend. If you're ready to invest a little time and a lot of love, Darla is ready to show you just how special she is. Darla's adoption fee is sponsored by an anonymous donor! Less

clark.name: Rita
clark.bio: Rita is a 4-year-old Domestic Shorthair who came in with Tom Tom and is still learning that the world and people can be safe. She is not very socialized yet and tends to be shy in new situations, preferring to observe from a distance rather than jump right into interaction. Because of her background, Rita will need a patient home that allows her to adjust at her own pace without pressure. She may take time to warm up, but with consistency and a calm environment, she has the potential to build confidence and slowly learn trust. Rita would do best in a quiet home where routines are predictable, and she can feel secure. She's not the type to demand attention, but she deserves a space where she can finally relax and just be herself. For someone willing to give her time and understanding, Rita can blossom into a quiet, steady companion. Less

clark.name: Teller
clark.bio: Meet Teller, a brilliant young dog with a thoughtful heart and a story that's led her right back to us through no fault of her own. At just 10 months old, this Rat Terrier and Cattle Dog mix already shows off her impressive intelligence and communication skills. She even knows how to use a button to let you know when she needs to go potty! Teller was originally adopted but sadly returned due to changes in her owner's circumstances. Because of that, she can be a little slow to trust when meeting new people and adjusting to new environments. She likes to take her time observing the world and figuring out who feels safe. But once Teller decides you're her person, she truly shines. She becomes a deeply loyal, affectionate, and devoted companion who sticks close and bonds hard. Her smart, attentive nature makes her an incredible partner for someone willing to give her patience and consistency. With her mix of brains, sensitivity, and heart, Teller will thrive in a calm, understanding home that lets her open up at her own pace. In return, she offers one of the most rewarding bonds you can ask for. Teller isn't just looking for a home, but is looking for someone to trust completely. Less

clark.name: Piper
clark.bio: Piper is a big, goofy Pit mix with an even bigger heart! Piper came to us after her owner went away to college and was no longer able to keep her. It’s never easy when a dog loses the person they thought would be theirs forever, but Piper is ready to put that chapter behind her and find a family who is ready to make a lifelong commitment. This girl is lovable, silly, and full of personality. She’s the kind of dog who can bring a little laughter into your day just by being herself. Piper doesn’t need perfection—she just needs someone who will love her, include her, and make sure she knows she’s home for good this time. If big dogs with big hearts are your thing, Piper is waiting to meet you! Less

clark.name: Oakley
clark.bio: This Beautiful Husky mix came to us as a stray, and she certainly knows how to turn heads! Oakley weighs 56 pounds and has one of those classic Husky looks that’s hard to resist—including those gorgeous blue Husky eyes! Now that Oakley is safe with us, she’s hoping it won’t be long before she finds someone who will give her a place to call home. With her striking good looks and Husky charm, we think this girl is going to have no trouble stealing someone’s heart. Come meet Oakley and see those beautiful blue eyes for yourself! Less

clark.name: Delayne
clark.bio: Don't let the name fool you, Delayne is all boy! Delayne is an 11-month-old mixed hound with a handsome brown and white coat and a whole lot of life ahead of him! This sweet boy made his way to us through transport, and now he's hoping his next journey will be the best one yet: straight into a forever home! At just 11 months old, Delayne is still a young pup with plenty of growing, learning, and adventures ahead of him. He's ready to leave shelter life behind and find a family to call his very own. Could Delayne be the missing piece to your family? Less

clark.name: Peter Parker
clark.bio: Your friendly neighborhood kitten has arrived! Meet Peter Parker, a 17-week-old short-haired kitten with a handsome white and orange coat and a name that’s practically destined for adventure! Peter is at that fun kitten age where everything is worth investigating, every corner could hold a new discovery, and life is one big adventure waiting to happen. He’s ready to find a family who will help him grow, keep him entertained, and give him a safe, loving place to call home. You don’t need radioactive spiders to find your next superhero… just a little room in your heart for this adorable boy! Could Peter Parker be the hero your home has been waiting for? Less

clark.name: Venkman
clark.breed: German Shepherd Dog / Terrier (Unknown Type, Small)
clark.bio: Meet Venkman, a handsome 12-week-old German Shepherd mix who's ready to become your newest partner in crime... we mean ghostbusting! Named after the legendary Ghostbuster, Venkman has some pretty big shoes to fill. Luckily, he's got four adorable paws to help him out! He's searching for a family ready to teach him the ropes, survive the puppy stage, and give him a lifetime of love. Who needs a proton pack when you've got puppy kisses? Less

clark.bio: Tom Tom is a Tom Tom cat.

clark.name: Bugs
clark.bio: Bugs is a busy little kitten with a big personality packed into a tiny body. He loves batting around toys, wrestling with his siblings, and investigating every corner he can reach. His playful antics are sure to keep his future family entertained. Bugs is looking for a home where he can continue to grow, learn, and be loved.

clark.name: Meenie
clark.bio: Say hello to Meenie! This sweet kitten is ready to bring some fun, purrs, and personality into a lucky family’s life. Meenie is part of a lovable sibling group with Bo, Eenie, Minie, and Mo. Meenie enjoys the simple pleasures of kitten life — playtime, exploring, and discovering new things every day. With love, guidance, and plenty of attention, Meenie will grow into a fantastic feline friend. Meenie is ready to start the next chapter of their story. Could it be with you? Less

clark.name: Hendrix
clark.bio: Hendrix is a little terrier mix with a rockstar personality! He is energetic, playful, goofy, and always ready to turn the volume up to eleven. Like any good terrier puppy, Hendrix is curious about EVERYTHING. He loves to play, explore, wrestle, zoom around, and generally make sure there is never a dull moment. He’s got a fun-loving personality and plenty of puppy energy that will need an outlet through play, exercise, training, and enrichment. If your idea of the perfect puppy includes a little bit of chaos, a lot of laughs, and an adorable face you can’t resist, Hendrix could be your next best friend!

clark.name: Lennon
clark.bio: Lennon is a goofy little terrier mix who is always ready for fun! He’s energetic, playful, curious, and has absolutely no shortage of puppy personality. Lennon loves to run, wrestle, explore, and join in on whatever his siblings are doing. He has the classic terrier enthusiasm and can be delightfully loud when he feels like sharing his thoughts with the world. He’s still young and learning, so his future family should be prepared for plenty of puppy energy, training, chewing, zoomies, and general silliness. With the right family, Lennon will have everything he needs to grow into a happy, well-rounded companion—and he’s sure to provide plenty of laughs along the way! Less

clark.name: Nana
clark.bio: For too long, Nana's world was limited to four basement walls. Abandoned alongside her companions, Reyn and Connie, she waited patiently for someone to find her—and thankfully, that day finally came. Now Nana is getting the chance to experience all the things every dog should know: kindness, security, soft beds, full bellies, and people who wont leave her behind. She's a beautiful coonhound with so much love still waiting to give to the right family. Nana doesn't need a perfect home—she just needs one that's patient, understanding, and ready to show her that forever really can mean forever. If you're looking for a loyal friend whose best days are still ahead, Nana is waiting to meet you! Less

clark.name: Coletta
clark.bio: Coletta is one of those dogs who makes you want to slow down and give her a little time. This sweet mix-breed girl is wonderfully mellow and is just waiting for someone to give her the chance to really come out of her shell. We have a feeling there is a whole lot more personality hiding behind that calm exterior, just waiting for the right home to bring it out. Coletta doesn’t need someone looking for the wildest or most energetic dog in the room. She needs someone willing to give her patience, affection, and the security of knowing she finally has people she can count on. clark.name: Lorelai
clark.bio: Lorelei is one of our adorable Gilmore Girl litter puppies! This sweet Rat Terrier/Border Collie mix is ready to find someone who will love her through every stage of life. Lorelei is smart and lovable and is just beginning to figure out what the big wide world is all about. Her future family will get to help her learn everything from the important basics to all the little things that make a dog a wonderful member of the family. She’s looking for someone who is ready for puppyhood—the training, the adventures, the occasional mischief, and all those precious cuddles. Lorelei is ready to write her next chapter.

adams.name: Pika
adams.bio: The first thing people notice about Pika is that she is a senior cat, but once you meet her and she has warmed up to you, you'd never believe it. This sweet girl has had a rough life so far and she wears her fear in her gaze. She takes a fair bit to warm up, but she is learning what love is every day. She still gets scared and is easily overstimulated, so she would need someone patient and calm who will not overwhelm her as she continues to open up. She enjoys gentle belly rubs, pets on her head and shoulders (NOT her rump!), and being spoken to with soothing words of encouragement. She will give affectionate headbutts and even enjoys the rare kiss on her noggin. She is known to lash out when startled, overwhelmed, or overstimulated, but is otherwise a very gentle sweetheart. She just needs someone who will respect her peace as she overcomes years of trauma and learns how to trust. Is that somebody you? Less

fetch.name: Gretzky
fetch.bio: Ello again...In case you forgot, I'm Gretzky. I've been in foster care for a long time now and I've really got a good schedule down. I'll tell you about it if you want....First I wake up and am excited to go potty outside. It's one of my favorite times and I may bark or nip your butt with excitement. Don't worry, I'm not /that/ excited. I just really have to pee. Then I come inside and lay on my beddy. It's my favorite spot. Unfortunately, I'm what my foster calls 'a babe magnet.' This means my canine and feline roommates will come to snuggle in my beddy with me, even in very warm temperatures. I don't understand it either. So we spend the next several hours rotating beddies until lunch, when we go back outside. Much sleeping is had. And snacks. Then the garage door opens and my room mates and I loose our collective minds because foster M'mam is home! I love her. And it means we get to do the best thing ever: walkies. I love pooping when I'm on a leash. I love walking. I don't need to smell anything, I don't care. I just like to walk. Especially in the woods! Sometimes we will see people on our walk. It makes me very nervous. Sometimes they will ask to pet me. I tell them 'No Thank You' by desperately trying to get away from them. Then I am edgy the rest of the walk. What if they secretly pop out of a bush to pet me?? Sometimes my foster M'mam will lock me in the bathroom and pet me. I've gotten used to this strange habit, but I don't really like it. Then, after food smells (someti

fetch.name: Russell
fetch.bio: I’M FREE! After 10 months in a small cage, I’m finally out and learning what it means to be a puppy. WOOHOO!I’m Russell, and I’m ready to make up for lost time. I’m looking for an active, patient family with another dog to run and play with — bonus points for a fenced yard where I can really let loose. I’m doing great with house training, and I’m working on my leash manners and getting comfortable in my crate. Now that I’ve discovered toys (and, okay, also magazines ), I’m all about chewing, playing, and exploring everything I missed out on. I’ve got a lot of energy and I’m eager to learn — I just need you to help me burn it off with walks, runs, and plenty of stimulation. Think we could be a match? Apply for me — I’m Russell, and I can’t wait to meet you! You can apply for me at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Fortune
fetch.bio: As Fortune approaches two years in foster care, everyone who knows him is asking the same question: How has this wonderful boy not been adopted yet? Fortune is a sweet, gentle Great Pyrenees mix who's simply looking for a patient family willing to give him the time he needs to feel safe. Once he trusts you, you'll have one of the most loyal companions you could ask for. Fortune is truly an easy dog to live with. He's fully potty trained, dog-door trained, and non-destructive when left home alone. He settles into a routine beautifully and asks for very little—just a safe place, a little patience, and someone to love. One of Fortune's favorite activities is going for walks, and he's an absolute gentleman on a leash. He also loves car rides, making him the perfect road trip companion. At home, you'll often find him relaxing in the sunshine or happily patrolling the yard, always keeping an eye out for squirrels, rabbits, and other critters. When he feels safe, he loves to run and explore, so a securely fenced yard is required. Fortune enjoys being brushed, does well during baths, and settles nicely in his kennel. With his low-to-medium energy level, he's just as happy lounging around the house as he is exploring the backyard. Fortune is shy, especially around men, and needs adopters who understand that trust takes time. He'll thrive with a family that allows him to adjust at his own pace and celebrates the little victories along the way. Watching him gain confidence is incredibly rewa

fetch.name: Zoey
fetch.bio: Hi, I’m Zoey! My smile goes for a million miles — which is exactly how far I can run! Don’t worry, though, I won’t run away from you. After a hard day of play, all I want is to snuggle up with you, because I’ve earned it! I’m very active, but I’m just as content watching you go about your morning or afternoon routine while I entertain myself. I have learned to give you my best puppy dog eyes while you’re busy, though — just to make sure I get some extra attention! I even love hopping into my crate for a little rest all on my own. I’m still working on my manners when I get excited to say hi — I used to jump up a lot, but I’m learning that I get way more love by keeping all four paws on the ground! I am eager to please and eager for attention, in whatever form it comes. The birds, rabbits, and squirrels around here haven’t caught on yet — they just run and fly away instead of sticking around to chat. Don’t they know how to have a conversation?!My tongue isn’t just for panting — it’s also for giving you all the kisses you could ever want. I’ll wrap my paws around yours and keep you close… as long as there aren’t any socks or Crocs nearby to distract me. I swear, “I thought that was a toy!” comes out of my mouth (sort of) way too often. They taste great — you should try it sometime! (Kidding. Mostly.) I always go potty outside, where I like to take care of business — and I definitely mix business with pleasure. I love big dogs and little dogs alike, though the little ones have a hard t

fetch.name: Turbo
fetch.bio: Meet Turbo Say hello to Turbo, a sweet 8-year-old Plott Hound who is ready to find a family of her very own! Turbo is a loving/sometimes playful/gentle/goofy pup who loves - walks, snuggling on the couch under a blanket, or just hanging out wherever you are. She is happiest when she is outside just soaking up some sun or in your bed with you at night. Her foster mom says, Turbo has been great. We have been working on counter surfing and barking. She is house-trained/crate-trained and leash-trained, but we have been working on that too as she is a hound and she likes to pull, which is understandable as they were bred to hunt after all. She is not fond of car rides, but loves to go in the car. She would do great with dogs/kids. Not sure about cats. Like every dog, Turbo has her own unique personality and may need a little time, patience, and encouragement while settling into a new home. But once she feels comfortable, she’ll reward you with plenty of love and loyalty. If you’re looking for a bed partner/goofy/loving companion who will be your best friend, Turbo might just be the one! Interested in giving Turbo a forever home? Apply to adopt and come meet this wonderful pup! You can apply for this pup at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Daisy Jo
fetch.bio: Meet the beautiful Daisy Jo! This sweet girl was adopted as a puppy from a local shelter and spent about 2½ years with her family, where she loved her humans, including the kiddos. Unfortunately, due to a family member’s allergies, Daisy found herself back at the shelter through no fault of her own. Understandably, Daisy was heartbroken and terrified in the shelter, so she was transferred to a foster home with Fetch, where she’s slowly learning that good things are still ahead of her. And guess what? Her sweet personality is starting to shine! Daisy Jo is a gentle, sensitive, and somewhat timid soul who just needs a little time to feel safe. She’s house-trained, crate-trained, and gets along with the resident dogs and cat. She may be a little hesitant to trust new humans at first, but once she realizes you’re one of the good ones, get ready for your heart to melt! This girl has a serious love-bug side! Once she feels comfortable, she’ll gently nudge her foster’s hand to request more affection. And bum scratches? Oh yes, please! Those are definitely high on her list of favorite things. Daisy also has a playful side! One of her favorite pastimes is playing fetch with her ball. She’ll proudly bring it right to you and place it in your hands, politely letting you know that your throwing services are needed immediately. After all, why should she have to ask twice? She also loves playing with one of the resident dogs and would enjoy having a furry friend of her own. Her ideal canin

fetch.name: Twinkle
fetch.bio: Meet Twinkle Twinkle is a sweet girl who is just beginning her journey of discovering what it's like to be a beloved family pet. She is learning that the world can be a safe and happy place filled with belly rubs, couches to lay on, and lots of love. Twinkle is making great progress with house and potty training and will thrive with a patient family willing to continue helping her learn. She is still coming out of her shell is a little shy at first, but every day she becomes a little more confident. One thing Twinkle knows for sure is that she loves other dogs! Her happiest moments are spent running, playing, and exploring outside. A secure fenced yard is her dream, and having another playful, confident dog in the home would help her continue to build confidence and show her the ropes. Twinkle currently lives with children and is doing well with them. Because she is still learning to trust and adjust to family life, she will need an understanding home that will let her settle in at her own pace. If you're looking for a gentle soul to nurture and watch blossom into the dog she was always meant to be, Twinkle may be the perfect addition to your family. With patience, love, and a canine companion by her side, this special girl is sure to shine. Therfore, we would LOVE a home together if possible. We do well with older children, and we even have cats at our foster home! We like to play with our foster siblings and LOVE walks. We'd love a home where we can cuddle or chill on the couch with you. No worries leaving us at home, Daisy will even give you her biggest smile when you return! Adam has responded to his insulin very well and is back on track, and is ready for a home that is willing to help him be healthy and happy! Adam needs to be on a low-carb diet (this is easy, and we can give you a list of good foods that ARE NOT expensive!) and he also needs to eat only twice a day, and receive his insulin 30 minutes after each meal. Because his diabetes went unmanaged for an unknown length of time before he arrived to us, he does walk a bit flat on his back legs.
